messages:
alex: Heads-up: Im seeing a stray token at the end of streaming outputs when stop matches and logprobs are requested. throwing this into the thread for async triage.

marta: thanks. can you paste the exact payload and runtime commit? helps reproduce locally.

alex: payload (curl simplified):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood/open-7b",
  "input": "List items:\n",
  "max_tokens": 40,
  "stop": ["\n\n"],
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "top_p": 1.0,
  "logprobs": 3,
  "stream": true
}
```
runtime: canary v2.14.3
observed stream chunks:
- "item1\nitem2" (partial)
- "\n\n" (stop match)
- "\n"  <-- extra stray token

jin: quick check  does non-streaming return the same trailing token?

alex: non-streaming returns a clean finish with finish_reason="stop" and no extra token. so this looks streaming-specific.

marta: hunch: we flush tokens earlier to compute logprobs; stop detection runs on the already-flushed stream which can cause an off-by-one emission. two mitigation strategies: buffer emission until stop is matched (adds latency), or compute logprobs out-of-band and suppress the final emit if stop matched (more complex).

sam: tradeoff question for product/contract: do we guarantee no extra tokens on streaming? customers may rely on strict stops. we need a decision on whether to prioritize correctness or tail latency for this canary.

lia: product view: prefer correctness. but if resolving it significantly increases P50, we should ship a doc note then fix. please measure impact.

jin: I can write unit tests for both stream and non-stream paths asserting the final emitted chunk ends exactly at the stop, and that last token logprob aligns with the emitted token list. will also add a mock path for logprob flush.

marta: plan: spike prototype for out-of-band logprob calc (suppress final emit if stop matched). if too brittle, fallback to buffered emission and quantify added latency.

ops-bot: canary window proposed: 2026-03-20T18:30:00Z in us-west-2 pending PR merge. :robot_face:

alex: added a short streaming client snippet and full trace to the issue; will paste PR link here when open.

sam: docs team: we need a short blurb on streaming semantics if we go doc-first. who can own this?

lia: Ill own docs + release note blurb. lia -> lia. will coauthor with marta for technical wording. target: same-day update if we choose doc-first.

marta: action items: 
- marta: spike PR for suppressing final emit (in progress)
- jin: add unit + integration tests for stream/non-stream stop behavior
- alex: attach streaming trace + client snippet to issue
- lia: draft docs + release notes
- sam: monitor post-canary metrics/errors

marta: rough ETA: 2d for spike, 4	6d for PR + tests. if spike shows complex edgecases, we will ship doc-first and schedule fix.

alex: thanks all. ping me for code review and Ill validate with our internal client. :thumbsup:
